result.title: Persistent Identity in Person Tracking: Online Enrollment and Registered Recognition
result.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. An earlier version of this paper was submitted to an IEEE conference
result.summary: We extend PoseTReID with online appearance-bank matching (Gallery) and a residual-conflict guard for registered SVM recognition. All methods use supplied ground-truth (GT) person boxes. We average all-box assessment IDF1/HOTA equally across videos. On six SportsMOT clips, StrongSORT leads standalone trackers (79.44/84.72%) and exceeds both Gallery variants. Over eleven videos, Gallery AIN (83.29/85.44%) and COPE (84.66/86.38%) exceed standalone trackers with complete results. This lead depends on two retrospectively added GTA development compilations and is absent on the original nine videos. Registered SVMs lead both cohorts among complete results, with AIN at 95.72/94.82% over eleven videos. They use every GT crop from approximately 20% of frames, including future appearances. On MOT20-03, registered AIN reached 96.80% IDF1 and assigned the correct enrolled name to 90.72% of assessment GT observations. Gallery and standalone trackers receive no per-video labelled enrollment. Both identity routes restore identities across internal title cards, but Gallery trails SORT on three videos (four in HOTA) and both SVMs trail SORT on MOT16-04/MOT20-03. Under six-clip persistent-only scoring, native Gallery gains 2.39 percentage points in mean IDF1 over a matched control, with lower correct-P coverage and 5.02 times as many encoder attempts. Pose gating is mixed; the guard's metric effect is not isolated.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作在人跟踪框架 PoseTReID 上加入在线外观库匹配与注册式 SVM 识别，并在 SportsMOT、MOT16/MOT20 上评估身份保持效果及其对评测口径的敏感性。
AI.relevance_reason: 内容属于多目标跟踪与行人重识别的指标与评测问题，依赖 GT 框和未来帧裁剪，未涉及视觉推理中的 latent 状态、证据筛选或停止决策，且无可迁移的状态更新或训练监督线索。
